services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Vans from Dickinson College leave at 8:30 am from the plaza of Weiss Center for the Arts for students and staff who would like a ride. They return at 10:30 a.m. Join Jesse Price, Land Stewardship Director for the Central Pennsylvania Conservancy, for a hands-on workshop exploring an innovative way to support local wildlife while managing invasive plants. Participants will learn how to construct a hibernaculum, an overwintering shelter that provides critical refuge for wildlife during freezing winter temperatures when natural habitat is limited.
